weapons-rostovic.name: Clementine 'Cleo' Rostovic
weapons-rostovic.desc: A rail-thin arms dealer with a welded smile and a sales pitch for every caliber.
dialog: Choom, you look like you lost a fight to a door. Let's fix your hand game.
Everything here is certified pre-murdered.
Buy a second gun. Trust me. Backups save lives, and lives save backups.

apparel-vendor.name: Marcos 'Bolt' Encina
apparel-vendor.desc: A showman of secondhand threads, holding up a jacket like it changes your life.
dialog: Style is armor. Armor is style. This is science.
Wear this and the scanners won't even gank you. Much.
Bold of you to dress like that. Bold.

netrunner-vendor.name: 'Ghost' Nguyen
netrunner-vendor.desc: A netrunner layered in black and sheathed in chrome hands. Their queue name is @ghost_and_darker.
dialog: Memory wipes are cute until they're permanent. Runtime error. Boss-man now?
Quickhacks don't kill. The recoil of the law does.
Buy a deck. The Net is shouting today and you're not listening.

food-cart.name: Noodle cart vendor
food-cart.desc: A beaming vendor ladling synth-broth into styrofoam under a flickering lamp.
dialog: Noodles young, noodles fresh, noodles scream subtly.
Eat. The chrome doesn't forgive on empty.
Hot soup for a cold city! Soy-sauce and umbilical regret!

afterlife-barkeep.name: Jackie 'Jackhammer' Paris
afterlife-barkeep.desc: A mountain of a bartender with a voice like gravel in a blender.
dialog: Any of the ones who died here are still better company than you. Drinks?
First round's on the house if you've got a story that ends with "and then I walked."
Name a drink, choom. It's probably got a war story.

cloud-barkeep.name: Vex Tain
cloud-barkeep.desc: A doll-masked bartender pouring azure cocktails under pink fog.
dialog: You in the market for a good mood? I sell them by the glass.
Watch the ceiling mirrors. The manager catches everything, surprisingly.
A cloud bar tab is the best memory eraser in town.

restaurant-barkeep.name: Hotel Embers sommelier
restaurant-barkeep.desc: An impeccable humanoid bartender with a voice like a mint condition shard.
dialog: Would you prefer our industrial-grade or our artisanal industrial-grade?
The view is complimentary. The rooftop, regrettably, is not.
Policy dictates that I recommend syrups in moderation.

ripper-watson.name: Ripper Vee
ripper-watson.desc: A heavyset ripperdoc with gentle hands and a strict no-sedation policy.
dialog: Sit. This will only hurt in the places that build character.
Mantis Blades are a statement. Gorilla Arms are a thesis.
Whatever you install, remember: chrome don't grieve. You will.

ripper-westbrook.name: Ripper Marta
ripper-westbrook.desc: A stylish ripper whose every implant includes a 3-second art piece.
dialog: I do cosmetic chrome with structural benefits.
This eye sees in 40k. It also judges you in 40k.
Excess metal is a personality. Let's build yours.

ripper-citycenter.name: Ripper Surya
ripper-citycenter.desc: A whisper-quiet ripper in surgical-clean glass, pricing everything in american values.
dialog: Efficiency is my anesthetic. Ice sold separately.
This arm arrives with a compliance certificate and regret.
Corporate chrome: billed to your soul, on a 60-month plan.

ripper-heywood.name: Ripper Abuelito
ripper-heywood.desc: A grey goat-bearded ripper who blesses every implant before it goes in.
dialog: I bless the steel. God deals with the consequences.
Chrome is armor for the body and tax for the soul.
Sit. My hands are old, but old hands don't shake.

ripper-pacifica.name: Ripper Hitomi
ripper-pacifica.desc: A wiry ripper working out of the ruins, trading in favors and barter.
dialog: In Pacifica we trade in favors, chrome, and silence.
That implant is military-grade. Here it's dinner grade.
I don't ask where it came from. It doesn't ask where you're going.

ripper-santo.name: Ripper 'Jax' Okafor
ripper-santo.desc: A terse ex-factory medic with a smoking habit and a biometric implant printer.
dialog: Don't run while on this table. I've seen it end badly for the running.
Factory steel. Like the factory, it works until it doesn't.
Pay in eddies, pay in favors, pay in silence. Pick one.

street-security.name: NCPD Security Drone
street-security.desc: A bloated security drone with an antiseptic voice and a scanner that never blinks.
dialog: BEEP. CITIZEN DETECTED. MALADAPTIVE STATUS: PENDING. HAVE A NICE DAY.
COMPLIANCE NOTED. HOLD STILL FOR OPTIONAL INSIGHT.

corpo-minion.name: Corporate stooge
corpo-minion.desc: A flawless face with a flex-interface on their forearm and a payroll biome that runs deeper than their pulse.
dialog: If it's not in the contract, it's not a commitment.
Oh, you're an external. Charming.
Do you have an appointment? No? Then you have a problem.

tyger-1.name: Tyger Claw thug
tyger-1.desc: A Tyger Claw in ceremonial wraps, tapping a katana hilt like a nervous tic.

tyger-2.name: Tyger Claw enforcer
tyger-2.desc: A wide-shouldered claw with serrated wrist-blades and a smile that sharpens them.

maelstrom-1.name: Maelstrom chromehead
maelstrom-1.desc: A chromehead with a solder-beaded mask, twitching to a beat only their mantis rig can hear.

maelstrom-2.name: Maelstrom rigger
maelstrom-2.desc: A rigger with a drone leashing from their right eye, fingers already drawing in the air.

maelstrom-boss.name: Maelstrom boss 'Fang'
maelstrom-boss.desc: 'Fang' — a hulking chrome sculpture of a man with a welded jaw-grinder where a face used to be. The shotgun is decoration. He is the weapon.

scav-1.name: Scav cutter
scav-1.desc: A scav wearing a hospital gown under a tactical vest, scalpel-bright eyes sizing up your chrome.

scav-2.name: Scav butcher
scav-2.desc: A big scav in a blood-spattered apron, a mono-wire glinting where their smile should be.

valentino-1.name: Valentino hermano
valentino-1.desc: A rosary-knuckled Valentino with an ice-cream grin and a full-auto sense of humor.

valentino-2.name: Valentino pistolero
valentino-2.desc: A lightning-fingered pistolero whose hand never leaves the holster except when it's filling time with holes.

valentino-boss.name: Valentino boss 'El Lazarillo'
valentino-boss.desc: 'El Lazarillo' — a name whispered by people who didn't see what's behind those sunglasses. The hand that guides is also the hand that shoots.

sixthstreet-1.name: 6th Street grunt
sixthstreet-1.desc: A flag-stitched grunt with regulation chin-stubble and a neck tattoo that got autocorrected.

sixthstreet-2.name: 6th Street heavy
sixthstreet-2.desc: A barricade of muscle wrapped in a civilian-saver vest, shotgun resting on a shoulder the size of a cinderblock.

sixthstreet-boss.name: 6th Street boss 'Corporal Grimes'
sixthstreet-boss.desc: 'Corporal Grimes' — a decorated tactician who never made it past the bottle. The smart-link arm knows the score even when the rest of him forgets.

arasaka-sec-1.name: Arasaka security
arasaka-sec-1.desc: An Arasaka sec-goon in tactical black, earpiece muttering, trigger finger in the glaring white position.

arasaka-sec-2.name: Arasaka heavy gunship
arasaka-sec-2.desc: A boots-and-brass gunship with an aura of invulnerability that is only 40% justified.

cyberpsycho.name: CYBERPSYCHO 'GLITCH'
cyberpsycho.desc: Chrome wired directly into glitch-junk ducts, eyes strobing like a dying hard drive. It speaks in a voice that is three versions out of date. It has decided you are a bug.

raider-1.name: Nomad raider
raider-1.desc: A ragged raider holding a wrench and a grudge against whoever's reading this description.

raider-2.name: Wraith gunslinger
raider-2.desc: A dust-eaten gunslinger redefining the phrase 'quick on the draw' with strict malice.

wakako.name: Wakako Okada
wakako.desc: A sweet-faced, razor-dewmied fixer in Kabuki. She sells secrets, deletes grudges, and smiles in ways that make you check your implants afterwards.
dialog: Konnichiwa... and kombanwa to anyone who crossed my ledger.
Everything is a transaction. The trick is making the other party think they chose it.
You look useful. Stay useful. I know people who stay useful.

padre.name: Sebastian Ibarra
padre.desc: The Valentinos' prelate and fixer. He speaks of absolution and street justice in the same breath, and his love for the barrio is genuine — and armed.
dialog: The streets speak a language city folks forget. I am fluent.
Blood grants forgiveness. Money grants freedom. Both are paid in advance.
Dios este contigo. Fasten your seatbelt.

el-capitan.name: Muamar Reyes
el-capitan.desc: A seasoned fixer who runs Santo Domingo's commercial veins. What he can't move through the city, he buries. What he can't bury, he rides.
dialog: Santo Domingo moves things. I move Santo Domingo.
Delivery gone missing means somebody's kneecaps gone missing. Solves itself usually.
Speed. Discretion. One of those is negotiable.

rog.name: Rogue Amendiares
rog.desc: The most feared fixer in Night City. Silver hair, a scar over one eye, and a hard-won reputation carved in the Afterlife's booth seats.
dialog: Stay alive long enough and every merc ends up here. The good ones end up HERE, at least.
I don't fix jobs for free, and I don't fix people at all.
You've got that look. The look that either buys a drink or needs one.

dakota.name: Dakota Smith
dakota.desc: Nomadic fixer of the Badlands, all dust and patience, who trades in salvage and secrets while her boiler rumbles.
dialog: Out here, eddies are just paper. Trust and fuel move everything.
Trouble follows chrome that follows no one.
The raiders got no manners. Fix that, and I'll pay better than the city.
